title: An infinite family of minimally nonperfectly divisible graphs with a bisimplicial vertex
summary: We disprove Hoàng's conjecture that a minimally nonperfectly divisible graph cannot contain a bisimplicial vertex by constructing an explicit infinite family. For every integer $t\geq1$, the graph $G_t$ in this family has clique number three, contains a bisimplicial vertex of degree four, and satisfies \[ |V(G_t)|=93+30(t-1),\qquad |E(G_t)|=320+104(t-1). \] In particular, the members are pairwise nonisomorphic.
